record.context_brief: mixed parabolic and hyperbolic leaf types
record.original_question: Let Z be a holomorphic vector field on C2. Can there be one positive-measure set of leaves whose universal covers are C and another positive-measure set of leaves whose universal covers are the unit disc?

evidence.quote: Problem 8.1. Let Z be a holomorphic vector field in C2. (i) Is it possible to have a set of positive measure of leaves covered by C and another set of positive measure of leaves covered by the unit disc ?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $Z$ be a holomorphic vector field on $\mathbb{C}^2$, and consider the singular holomorphic foliation $\mathcal{F}$ on $\mathbb{C}^2$ whose leaves are the orbits of $Z$ (away from the singular set $\{Z=0\}$). Each leaf $L$ of $\mathcal{F}$ is a Riemann surface, and by the uniformization theorem its universal cover $\widetilde{L}$ is biholomorphic to either the Riemann sphere $\mathbb{CP}^1$, the complex plane $\mathbb{C}$ (parabolic case), or the unit disc $\mathbb{D}$ (hyperbolic case). Equip $\mathbb{C}^2$ with Lebesgue measure (or any measure in its class). 

Question: Can it happen that the set of points $p\in\mathbb{C}^2$ whose leaf $L_p$ has universal cover biholomorphic to $\mathbb{C}$ has positive measure, while at the same time the set of points $p\in\mathbb{C}^2$ whose leaf $L_p$ has universal cover biholomorphic to the unit disc $\mathbb{D}$ also has positive measure?
artifact.status_search_result: A targeted web search did not surface a published resolution of the question of whether a holomorphic vector field on $\mathbb{C}^2$ can simultaneously have a positive-measure set of parabolic leaves (covered by $\mathbb{C}$) and a positive-measure set of hyperbolic leaves (covered by $\mathbb{D}$). The status appears unresolved in the accessible literature.

status_evidence.title: Complete polynomial vector fields on C^2, Part I
status_evidence.snippet: Discusses singular holomorphic vector fields and foliations on C^2, including leaf-uniformization questions, without resolving the mixed-type measure question.
status_evidence.claim: Closely related work on holomorphic vector fields on C^2 does not record a resolution of the mixed parabolic/hyperbolic positive-measure question.

status_evidence.title: Foliated Hyperbolicity and Foliations with Hyperbolic Leaves
status_evidence.snippet: Surveys foliations whose leaves are uniformly hyperbolic, with discussion of when leaves are parabolic vs hyperbolic.
status_evidence.claim: Surveys related to leafwise uniformization on holomorphic foliations do not announce a solution to the question.
